recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片箭頭處為圓核、染色質較細的細胞，胞質充滿粗大橘褐色嗜伊紅顆粒並夾雜少量暗色顆粒，這是嗜伊紅性骨髓細胞（eosinophilic myelocyte）；對照旁邊顆粒細小的嗜中性前驅細胞可看出差異。
features: Arrowed cell with a round, eccentric nucleus and moderately condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm filled with coarse, refractile orange-brown eosinophilic granules with some darker granules
Cell size similar to adjacent neutrophilic myelocytes
Surrounding promyelocytes/myelocytes, a band neutrophil, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
Background of red cells and scattered vacuole artifacts
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixture of granulocytic and erythroid precursors. The arrowed cell has a round eccentric nucleus and cytoplasm packed with coarse orange-brown eosinophilic granules with a few darker granules, identifying it as an eosinophilic myelocyte. Neighboring neutrophilic promyelocytes and myelocytes contain finer, less refractile granules. This image illustrates normal eosinophilic precursor morphology rather than a specific disease.

ddx.vs: Has a larger nucleus with a Golgi zone and fine azurophilic purple granules rather than coarse orange refractile granules.
Contains coarse dark blue-black granules that overlie the nucleus rather than orange-pink granules.
Larger cell with dense dark metachromatic granules and a central round nucleus, often in particles.
